name: KS — Korean Standards for Construction
description: Validates BOQ items and specifications against key KS (Korean Standards) for construction materials and methods published by KATS. Covers KS F 4009 (ready-mixed concrete), KS D 3504 (reinforcing steel bars), KS F 2526 (aggregates for concrete), KS F 4021 (insulation materials), and related material standards. Checks that specification clauses cite the applicable KS standard number and that material grades match the KS classification.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: KATS (Korean Agency for Technology and Standards)
